description.narrative: Strengthening development funds management capabilities in national/subnational governments in Pacific Island Countries & Territories has been a key priority among development partners including UNDP where the aim is to make local service delivery and utilization of funds / investments more transparent, efficient, and effective. UNDP has been working with various institutions under Government of Kiribati while operationalizing robust risk assessment and monitoring framework under UNDP Harmonised Approach to Cash Transfer (HACT) framework.The financial management areas will be considered as a priority for institutional capacity strengthening such as Project Management; Financial Management; Assets & Inventory Management; and Procurement & Contract Management.

title.narrative: Thematic Evaluation: Thematic Evaluation: UNDP’s Contribution to Women’s Leadership and Empowerment in the Pacific at Mid-Term Stage of Implementation of the Multi Country Programme Document, 2023-2027

condition.narrative: The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
